verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the full loop. Loops fine-tunes a supported base model, and Training Jobs run your own Axolotl or TRL code on managed GPUs. Checkpoints sync to storage, and any checkpoint deploys as a production endpoint on the same platform with one CLI command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the fine-tune-to-serve workflow (all evidence is vendor docs).
